avis.texte: I love the packaging and the rollerball applicator, but unfortunately the product itself is too strong for my skin, causing an uncomfortable burning sensation in my eyes.
I think everyone should try it.It feels so good on your eyes
I believe this product, amongst others, is helping to decrease the look of a scar on my upper eyebrow area.

avis.titre: Good but I think think I'll try something else next time
avis.texte: Been using the product for about a month. It does help minimize some puffiness and firm undereye area. The area also feels more moisturized. Use it on forehead where a few wrinkles and works well. But bottle says use once a day and I do because I have really sensitive skin and it irritates it when used too many days in a row. Half a pump is usually enough for both eyes for me.

First Tirtir skin product I bought due to lines around eyes/forehead at age 36. Love what it does and helps with when added to my skincare routine! Minimizes lines where I can definitely tell a difference. They don't disappear completely but this helps reduce their appearance hands down. Im impressed.

Bought this on sale, tried it for a month and have seen great results. My undereye area feels hydrated, firmer, and even less dark than before. It doesn't feel greasy or tacky and applies so easy! Plus the packaging and applicator feel high end and durable.

I've been using this product for at least a month now. I use during my daily evening skincare routine. I love the roller the comes with and how it dispenses a good amount of product. The packaging is comparable to high end prestige products but most importantly, it is providing me with the result I was looking for - a smoother and firmer undereye. I will definitely keep using it to see more and more improvement long term. I highly recommend this product for smoothing out undereye wrinkles and excellent moisture all day long.

This is by far my favorite night-time eye cream I have ever used. It feels cooling because of the formula and the rollerball, though I prefer to put some under my eye first with my ring finger and then use the rollerball so the eye cream does not go too far down on my cheeks. It is moisturizing while feeling light on the skin. I have been using it for just over a week and will repurchase when it gets low. I use a different eye cream during the day that is reflective.

avis.titre: Great if you get milia but need hydration!
avis.texte: When you're prone to milia AND dry eyelids, it can be super hard to find a lightweight eye cream that is still hydrating enough. This is a great gel-cream that is plumping and hydrating without being heavy!

I bought this bc I was looking for something to plump my lines under my eyes. I'm 45 and the lines are getting deeper. I've been using consistently morning and night and I've seen a huge improvement! I roll a bit at a time all around my eyes including eyelids. However, I'm always dehydrated so I usually need to put a little bit of the moisturizer (same brand) to layer it on top. It absorbs really well! Great brand, excellent ingredients and products! Great for sensitive eyes!
I've been searching for a good eye cream for years. Tried them all, no matter the price. None have lived up to claims. But THIS right here? This is the one. Do not skip on it, buy it now.

My daughter bought me this to try and it's been a great addition to my routine. I like the convenience of the roller and it feels cool every time I apply it under my eyes. I'm very satisfied with the results and I will continue to use it.
